updates.title: Game 2: Brewers 5, Rays 4
body: Hi Baby, I hear this happened while you were inside: the Brewers took Game 2, 5 to 4. Abner Uribe gets the win. That is the box score version. The sidewalk outside Mo's will have the rest.

updates.title: Game 2 lineups are in
body: Hey Baby, both lineups are posted for Game 2. Brewers send Logan Henderson to the mound, the Rays answer with Drew Rasmussen. The cards are filled in and flipped-ready.
Here's that Bloody Mary info you asked for. I hope you find a tasty one. Y'all probably need it.

updates.title: Game 1: Brewers 3, Rays 2
body: Hi Baby, I hear this happened while you were inside: the Brewers took Game 1, 3 to 2. Jacob Misiorowski gets the win. That is the box score version. The sidewalk outside Mo's will have the rest.

updates.title: Hours change, so tap through
body: Hi Baby, hours and schedules come from the places themselves and they change, so tap through before you go.
Lineups land here the moment they post. The welcome is one tap away in the menu if you want it again.
